        cents = cents[:2].zfill(2)
    else:
        dollars = price_str
        cents = '00'

    dollars = dollars.replace('.', '')

    return total_cents

    dollars = total_cents // 100
    cents = total_cents % 100

    dollars_str = f"{dollars:,}".replace(',', '.')

        return dollars_str
    else:
        return f"{dollars_str}.{cents:02d}"
